items.text: The page titles are different. A's title is just the brand name, and B adds the hero tagline.
items.evidence: A title: "AEP Texas"; B title: "AEP Texas | Knowledge Is Power"

items.text: A uses a single custom typeface across the whole page. B uses system sans-serif fonts.
items.evidence: A fonts_by_element_count: din-2014 (1382 elements); B: Helvetica Neue (121), Arial (6)

items.text: A's H1 wraps onto two lines on the left side of the hero. B's H1 sits on one line, starting further in and spanning most of the hero width.
items.evidence: A slice 0: 'KNOWLEDGE IS / POWER.' at left; B slice 0: 'KNOWLEDGE IS POWER.' on a single line starting at about x=270

items.text: A shows the hero subtext as plain dark text followed by a red circular arrow icon. B puts the subtext in bold white type inside a solid red box.
items.evidence: A slice 0: gray 'Due to the pandemic…' with a red play icon; B slice 0: red rectangle containing white bold text

items.text: B's hero image is a full-bleed img element with a dimming overlay. A shows the same photo brightly, with a light fade on its left side behind the text.
items.evidence: B images: phone.jpg rect x=0, w=1440, h=440; A slice 0 shows a light-washed left side, while B's photo appears darkened

items.text: A's quick-link bar has four colored line icons with large two-line uppercase labels on a light translucent background. B's bar is dark charcoal with short white bold labels and no icons.
items.evidence: A slice 0: blue, orange, teal and green circular icons with 'ELECTRIC CHOICE' etc.; B slice 0: dark bar with 'Electric Choice', 'Report an o

items.text: A's utility bar shows 'ESPAÑOL' in uppercase with a globe icon. B shows a small underlined 'Español' text link.
items.evidence: A slice 0 top-right: ESPAÑOL plus globe; B slice 0 top-right: underlined 'Español'

items.text: A places its logo at x=70 and lets content run nearly the full width. B uses a narrower centered container that starts at x=160.
items.evidence: A logo rect x=70, w=92; B logo rect x=160, w=74; B cards span x 160–1280

items.text: The primary LOG IN button has a larger corner radius on A. B gives it more vertical padding.
items.evidence: A primary_button radius 8px, padding 0px 27px; B radius 4px, padding 12px 24px

items.text: B shows the LED bulb tip as a single line in a light gray banner with an underlined red 'See how' link. A uses a separate 'See how' outlined button under a bulb icon.
items.evidence: B slice 0: gray strip 'Choosing LED bulbs can help save you more money. See how'; A slice 0: 'See how' bordered button

items.text: A's call-to-action buttons are outlined, with dark text on white. B's CTAs are solid red with bold white text.
items.evidence: A: 'Learn about incentives', 'Track your order', 'Get answers' are outlined; B: the same CTAs are filled rgb(218,41,28)

items.text: A sets its CTA text in a large, light weight. B's CTA text is smaller and bold.
items.evidence: A slice 0/2: large thin 'Learn about incentives'; B slice 0: bold 'Learn about incentives'

items.text: B puts the electric-car, business and new-customer promos together in a row of three equal cards.
items.evidence: B images: electric-car, woman-in-white-blouse and new-service each w=357, h=223 at y=1129

items.text: A overlays promo headings and text on top of the photos. B puts text in a white panel below each image.
items.evidence: A slice 1: 'SOLUTIONS FOR YOUR BUSINESS' over the photo; B slice 1: text in the white card area under the image

items.text: B's promo cards have rounded corners and drop shadows on a light gray section background. A uses no box shadows anywhere.
items.evidence: B box_shadows 3, background rgb(244,245,245); A box_shadows 0

items.text: A presents the outage-alerts promo in white, between two light gray rules, with an orange lightning icon, an orange heading and an outlined button. B uses a full-width red band with an underlined white heading and a white button.
items.evidence: A slice 1: orange 'Enroll in outage alerts' and bolt icon; B slice 1: red band, white 'Sign up today' button

items.text: B stacks the meter, outage and community features as alternating rows of image and text, with backgrounds switching between white and light gray.
items.evidence: B meter-status at x=160, y=1790; outages-faq at x=744, y=2276; community at x=160, y=2761, each w=536

items.text: A's footer opens with a full-width red band of large white uppercase links (SAFETY, COMPANY, CLEAN ENERGY, BUSINESS). B lists the same links as small white title-case text inside a dark footer.
items.evidence: A slice 2: red band; B slice 2: 'Safety Company Clean Energy Business' on charcoal

items.text: A shows the help phone number inside an outlined button-like box. B shows it as large bold white text.
items.evidence: A slice 2: '866.223.8508' in a bordered box; B slice 2: bold '866.223.8508'

items.text: A's footer links are bold and uppercase, and the privacy policy link is highlighted in red. B's footer links are normal-weight title case, with no red highlight.
items.evidence: A 'VISIT AEP.COM | INVESTORS | CAREERS', red 'View our Privacy Policy'; B 'Visit AEP.com | Investors | Careers'

items.text: B uses semantic landmark elements: header, main and sections. A has no header, main or section elements.
items.evidence: B semantic: header 1, main 1, section 5; A: header 0, main 0, section 0

items.text: B uses a native dialog element for its login form.
items.evidence: B tag_counts dialog 1, form 1, input 3

items.text: A lays out with flexbox only. B uses some CSS grid alongside flex.
items.evidence: A display_grid 0, display_flex 235; B display_grid 5, display_flex 10

items.text: B's page is taller than A's at the same width.
items.evidence: A page_height 3372; B 3501; both width 1440

items.text: A's main body text is gray. B's is near-black.
items.evidence: A body_color rgb(74,74,74); B body_color rgb(29,31,32)

items.text: Navigation labels are uppercase on A and sentence/title case on B ('My Account', 'Outages').
items.evidence: A slice 0 shows 'MY ACCOUNT, OUTAGES, SAVINGS…'. B shows 'My Account, Outages, Savings, Community, Contact'.

items.text: A has a magnifier search icon in the header, and the nav is bigger and more spread out. B has no search icon.
items.evidence: A slice 0 shows a search glyph at x~1340. B header ends with the LOG IN button.

items.text: Image corners differ. A's photos have square corners. B's feature images and cards have slightly rounded corners.
items.evidence: A border_radius bucket_1_7 35 across 1382 elements, mostly zero. B shows rounded image corners in the slices.

items.text: A's DOM is very large and deeply nested. B's is small and flat.
items.evidence: A div 638, a 267, li 240, span 106, script 26. B div 26, a 38, li 10, span 0, script 1.

items.text: A's heading outline includes many hidden or modal headings: 'Processing your request', 'Select your state handbook', 'Loading video...', a full privacy policy with h4s, 'Security Code' and 'Welcome back!'. A has 30 h6 elements. B has only 9 headings, ending with 'Welcome back!'.
items.evidence: A tag_counts h6 30, h4 7, h3 7, h2 4. B h2 5, h3 3, with no h4 or h6.

items.text: B's heading levels are structurally different. The promo cards are H3 under the 'Bring Home Energy Savings' H2, and the three feature blocks are H2. A uses H3 for the feature blocks and has no heading for the promo tiles inside the overlay.
items.evidence: B outline: h1, h2, h3 x3, h2 x3, h2 'Welcome back!'. A outline: the promo tiles are not listed as headings and the feature blocks are h3.

items.text: A relies on a heavy class and ARIA footprint. B has few classes and almost no ARIA.
items.evidence: A classes total 1597, unique 294, aria_attrs 141, inline_style_attrs 26. B classes total 44, unique 24, aria_attrs 3, inline_style_attrs 5.

items.text: A loads external scripts and stylesheets plus tracking pixels and an iframe. B is a single inline style block and one script.
items.evidence: A script 26, stylesheets 4, link 8, style 3, iframe 1, noindexfb 1, hidden px/pixel.gif images. B stylesheets 0, style 1, script 1.

items.text: The color palette is wider in A. It uses red, greys, blue (rgb(0,120,170) text, rgb(2,90,149)), orange and green icon accents, and a translucent white overlay. B reduces it to brand red, white, light grey rgb(244,245,245) and charcoal rgb(29,31,32).
items.evidence: A top_text_colors include rgb(0,120,170) and top_backgrounds include rgba(255,255,255,0.23) and rgb(2,90,149). B top_backgrounds are only wh

items.text: Transitions are defined on many more elements in A than in B. Neither has animations or transforms.
items.evidence: A transitions 291, B transitions 3. Both animations 0 and transforms 0.

items.text: B adds a hero photo (phone.jpg) not in A's image list. A instead uses the hero photo through a different mechanism, likely CSS background, since it isn't in A's images. B's feature images are real img elements.
items.evidence: B images include phone.jpg 2000x576 at 1440x440. A's list has no hero image.

features.statement: Page title appends the hero tagline to the brand name rather than using the brand name alone.
Text is set in generic system sans-serif fonts (Helvetica Neue/Arial) instead of a custom brand typeface.
Hero headline sits on a single line spanning most of the hero width rather than wrapping on the left.
Hero subtext is bold white type inside a solid red box, without an arrow icon.
Hero photo is a full-bleed img element with a darkening overlay.
Quick-link bar is dark charcoal with short bold white labels and no icons.
Navigation, links and footer labels use sentence/title case with normal weight instead of uppercase.
Content sits in a narrower centered container with wide side margins.
Buttons have small corner radius and generous vertical padding.
Call-to-action buttons are solid brand-red fills with bold white text.
Tip is a single-line light gray banner with an underlined red inline link rather than a button.
Promo items form a row of three equal cards with text in a white panel below each image.
Cards have rounded corners and soft drop shadows on a light gray section background.
Alert promo is a full-width solid red band with underlined white heading and white button.
Feature sections alternate image and text rows, with backgrounds switching between white and light gray.
Footer is dark charcoal with small white title-case links and the phone number as large bold text.
Markup uses semantic landmarks (header, main, sections) and a native dialog element for the login form.
Layout combines CSS grid with flexbox.
Body text is near-black rather than gray.
Header is minimal, with no search icon and a compact nav.
DOM is small and flat with few classes, minimal ARIA, no external assets and a single inline style block.
Heading hierarchy is clean, with few headings and promo cards as H3 under an H2.
Palette is restrained to brand red, white, light gray and charcoal.
Few elements define CSS transitions and there are no animations.
